steps.command:
set -eu
PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
export PATH
as_root() {
  if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; then
    "$@"
  else
    sudo -n "$@"
  fi
}
as_root install -d -o root -g root -m 0755 /var/log/inventory
printf '%s\n' 'inventory service started' 'inventory initial record count: 2' | as_root tee /var/log/inventory/app.log > /dev/null
as_root chmod 0644 /var/log/inventory/app.log
